title: Stay on 30A Property Management:Prescription for Paradise in Blue Mountain – Stay on 30A
meta_description: Stay on 30A Property Management: Prescription for Paradise in Blue Mountain. Welcome to Prescription for Paradise in Blue Mountain the ultimate luxury retreat along 30A! This incredible 7 bedroom home sleeps 16 guests, making it perfect large families or group getaways.
description_expanded: class="property_description"> Welcome to 'Prescription for Paradise'! Located in the heart of Blue Mountain Beach, this brand-new build offers an elevated 30A experience designed for larger groups seeking space, style, and effortless luxury. Thoughtfully designed with both comfort and connection in mind, Prescription for Paradise features a spacious five-bedroom main home, complemented by a two-bedroom carriage house, creating the ideal setup for multi-generational families, group getaways, or friends traveling together. This layout allows everyone to gather with ease while still enjoying the privacy and flexibility that makes extended stays feel seamless. Step inside the main home and you’re immediately met with a sense of effortless coastal sophistication. Warm textures, intentional design details, and an airy layout create a space that feels both elevated and inviting. The home flows naturally from one gathering space to the next, making it easy to linger over morning coffee, come together for meals, or relax after long days spent at the beach. The kitchen is both functional and beautiful, designed to handle group meals with ease while still feeling like a place people want to gather. Each bedroom serves as a calming retreat of its own, offering comfort, privacy, and a quiet place to unwind at the end of the day. Step outside to your private pool oasis, where afternoons melt into evenings and every moment feels unhurried. Whether you’re starting the day with a quiet swim, lounging poolside under the Florida sun, or enjoying evenings together beneath the stars, this outdoor space was designed to elevate your coastal escape. Exploring the area is just as effortless. Six adult bikes and six seater golf cart are included with your stay, making it easy to cruise Blue Mountain Beach, access nearby beach paths, and explore neighboring 30A communities at your own pace. Known for its laid-back atmosphere, scenic beauty, and proximity to local favorites, Blue Mountain Beach offers a more relaxed side of 30A. Perfect for guests looking to slow down without sacrificing access to the area’s best experiences. Prescription for Paradise  delivers a refined balance of thoughtful design, modern luxury, and coastal charm creating the perfect setting for meaningful moments, shared experiences, and unforgettable memories along 30A. HOME HIGHLIGHTS: -Steps From the Beach -6 Seater Golf Cart -Private Pool **Pool heating available for $50 per day** -Private Covered Porches with Outdoor Seating -6 Adult bikes -Close to Seaside & Grayton Beach -Carriage House With Bunk Room -Fully Equipped Gourmet Kitchen -Dry Bar with Ice Maker -Smart TVs  -Outdoor Kitchen with Built-in Gas Grill & Outdoor Seating Area -Outdoor Shower -Beach Gear including Pool Towels, Chairs, Umbrellas, Boogie Boards, Toys & Coolers -4 Dedicated Parking Spots  -Full Sized Washer and Dryer on Multiple Floors -Fenced in Yard -Bunk Beds ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps: 16   FIRST FLOOR: - Bedroom #1: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Half Bathroom SECOND FLOOR: - Bedroom #2: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combo - Bedroom #3: Bunk Room-Twin over Double  - Bedroom #4: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combo - Bedroom #5: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower & Soaker Tub CARRIAGE HOUSE: - Bedroom #6: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower only - Bedroom #7: Bunk Room- Twin over Full, Shared Bathroom with Shower only **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | Pool Towels WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | Coffee Filters | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING: Four driveway parking spaces available. Included are 6 bicycles (adult) & 6 seater golf cart for your convenience.  BEACH ACCESS Three public beach accesses a short distance from the home: 1. Gulfview Heights Beach Access is located 3 miles east of the intersection of Scenic 393 and Scenic 30A (Gulf Place). Turn south off Scenic 30A by Goatfeathers Seafood restaurant at Gulfview Heights street, then 1/4 mile to the gulf. This access has parking, restrooms, showers, picnic tables with shelter, and lifeguards during peak season. 2. Ed Walline Regional Beach Access is located at the intersection of Scenic 393 and Scenic 30A in Santa Rosa Beach, just across the street from Gulf Place rentals, shopping, and dining. This access is ADA accessible, and has two picnic shelters, parking, restrooms, and beach wheelchairs and lifeguards during peak season. Ed Walline Regional Access is unique among SoWal accesses with a two-story viewing platform overlooking the beach and gulf - a great place to spot surfers and dolphins. 3. Shellseekers Beach Access is a simple walkover at the end of Shellseekers Cove about one block south of Scenic 30A and a few blocks east of the Scenic 393 intersection at Gulf Place. It may be the most well hidden access in SoWal. BLUE MOUNTAIN COMMUNITY HIGHLIGHTS: -Blue Mountain is a laid-back coastal gem celebrated for its natural beauty, relaxed pace, and small-town charm. As the highest elevation along Scenic Highway 30A, it offers scenic dune views, peaceful beaches, and some of the most stunning sunsets on the Gulf. The area is dotted with beloved local spots, from homemade ice cream at Blue Mountain Beach Creamery to casual bites at Red Fish Taco and slow-smoked favorites from Blue Mabel Smokehouse. Locally owned shops, bike paths, and friendly gathering places add to the community feel, making Blue Mountain the perfect escape for those seeking an authentic, unhurried 30A experience. -Just a short bike or golf cart ride away is Gulf Place. A beach neighborhood where inspiration waits around every corner. Whether you’re a beach bum, foodie, shopper, or art lover, you’ll find your passion here. From live music venues to innovative art spaces, there’s a whole world to explore. Start your morning off right with a latte and sweet treat from Sunrise Coffee Co. After a walk along the shore or a quick dip in the gulf, grab a refreshingly cold local beer at Growler Garage. From Alabama ales to Florida sours, this local favorite brings brews to the beach. When it’s time to head to dinner, Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar’s fresh gulf seafood and views are unparalleled. And don’t forget to save room for dessert! Satisfy your sweet tooth with a Southern praline or waffle cone from Pecan Jack’s Ice Cream & Candy. Cava & Cakes and Shelby’s Beach Bar & Grill offer additional (and picture-perfect) sweet and savory favorites to round out your dining experience. Activities for every interest abound in Gulf Place. Unwind with a reflexology massage or enzyme facial at Awakening Wellness Organic Spa. Explore the palm tree-lined streets and neighborhood shops at Gulf Place Town Center. Ultimately, the best part of beach life is kicking off your shoes and feeling the sand between your toes. For sunset strolls and inspiring views, drift down to the Ed Walline Regional Beach Access. With ample parking, restrooms, bike racks and proximity to lifeguards in season, it couldn’t be more welcoming. -Flying in from out of town instead of driving? Flying into ECP (Panama Beach City) airport is a 50 minute drive to the house. Flying into VPS (Destin airport) is a 40 minute drive. HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck.  *No parties or events.  *Complimentary golf cart can only be operated by guests over 25 years of age who provide verification. Rental agreement requires a valid driver's license and proof of existing auto insurance coverage. *Private Heated Pool **Pool heating is available for an additional fee of $50/day. Must be heated for duration of stay.  If selected, it must be requested 48 hours prior to check in and paid before the heater will be turned on. *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. *Home must remain pet free. IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie". Both should be uploaded to our Happy Stays app. read more + less -
